rationale: Both candidates validate the worker seq_len fix and independently flag the same NPU mirror gap, but Y engages more precisely with the ground-truth Low concern (async_chunk default inconsistency between self.model_config and self.engine_client.model_config) and surfaces a genuinely deeper correctness issue (FINAL_ONLY list-vs-tensor divergence between _generate_audio_bytes and _generate_audio_chunks, plus the unmentioned WebSocket streaming path) with verified evidence and concrete file:line citations. X explicitly resolves the Med scoping concern more directly than Y, but pads its output with five near-duplicate 'Validated' entries restating the same scoping fact, diluting signal. Y's finding #7 on the fragile exact-match seq_len splitting (citing the span_len>1 branch) closely anticipates the multi-axis gap later fixed by PR #4910, while X raises no such concern.
